name: humanize
description: Improve user-facing prose by finding weak, repetitive language and proposing direct, specific revisions.

interface.shortDescription: Make user-facing prose direct and natural.
interface.longDescription: Review documentation and other user-facing prose for weak constructions, repetitive cadence, jargon, and unnecessary hedging, then propose clearer revisions without changing meaning.
defaultPrompt: Humanize this README without changing its meaning.
Review these docs for stiff or repetitive prose.
Make this user-facing copy more direct and specific.
